text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day after the Japanese Derby...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio once again asks to continue
training
without a rest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you know? They say the Kikuka
Sho
tests who's really the strongest
runner!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna surpass Prez, I gotta be
considered
that strong too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna do some more partner
running
today!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Who do you take me for? I'm
the
invincible Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
'Sides, the Kikuka Sho waits for no one!
This is no
time to rest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, she resumes training like usual.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Just a liiittle faster! Yaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Phew... Nice work, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you too! Thanks for running with
me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I gotta say, your running is incredible...
Aren't you
practically the number one
classic-year racer
already?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well my goal is to beat Prez, so
I've gotta
get even faster!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Teio keeps training with runner after
runner.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... You run so well, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I don't know what it is, but I can just feel how badly you want to win.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, gotta do what I gotta do if I'm
gonna
achieve my goa―

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ow!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Teio?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ouch! Oof, that hurts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere, Tokai Teio collapses
with a
grimace of great pain on her face!

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
This isn't the kind of damage that results
from just
a few days of training.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It's a much longer-term strain that's
finally
reached breaking point.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Teio, you must have known your legs
were in bad
condition, but you kept
running despite that,
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I've been feeling it ever since the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But I thought that if I stopped training,
there was
no way I could win the Kikuka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: Pushing through the pain to train...

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry to say, but the Kikuka Sho
might be
too much for someone in your
condition.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What?! N-no way!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: N-no! I can't afford to rest!
choice_data_list: Looks like training is on hold for...
Looks like training is on hold for...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, my legs do hurt, but... it's not that big of a deal!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let me train! I have to run in the Kikuka
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I... I don't care! I said I'm gonna enter!
choice_data_list: They said the 'Kikuka Sho' would b...
They said the 'Kikuka Sho' would b...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I need to win! It's the only way I can
show I'm
ready to take on Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If you won't support me, then I'll do it
myself! You
don't need to train me
anymore!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... G-get as mad as you like! See if I
care! I'm
not gonna change my mind!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez told me she was glad that I'd joined
her on
the same stage!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She's waiting for me to reach her! I can't
just stop
now and leave her hanging!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With tears welling up in her eyes, Tokai
Teio
gives me a look that tells me she's
not giving up.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I've always looked up to her! Before I
entered the
academy up till now! And I
always will!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No matter how strong Prez is, I won't
give up!
Ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even in the face of hardship, her dream
never
wavers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But what about me? Should I really just
give up?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Uh, Trainer? Why are you reading a
book all of
a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Acupuncture. Massages. Whatever the
method...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: I'll find a way for you to run at ...
I'll find a way for you to run at ...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You mean... you'll still let me run? I can
still train
for the Kikuka Sho?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah... you're right! Heheh... Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And... I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't have kept the pain a secret.
And I said some awful things just now
too... Even though I
know I can't do this
alone...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's a promise!
choice_data_list: Let's give it our all together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm gonna try to find ways to
recover too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Look, this book says hot springs have
healing
properties! Let's go on a hot
spring trip!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the days that follow, we do everything
we can to help her legs heal, and Teio
pushes through
the worst of it, avoiding
any chronic injuries.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a team, we ready ourselves for the
third
Classic race—the Kikuka Sho!
